en: A black and white vintage postcard image showing a scenic view of a river with a small waterfall, trees, buildings along the riverbank, and cliffs in the background. The upper part of the postcard contains text in Swedish, indicating the location and the involved photographer and distributor. The setting appears calm, rural, and slightly industrialized, suggesting a historical European town landscape.
